name: Pilot Rise
summary: Dallas and Fort Worth flight school that lists every aircraft by tail number on a dated rate sheet.
differentiator: Its rate sheet, updated September 19, 2026, names every charge beyond the hourly rate: a refundable deposit, a fuel surcharge, a late-cancel fee and a $10 a month fee for inactive accounts.
pricing: Cessna 172 at $165 to $180 an hour wet, Cessna 150 at $130, instructor $65 to $70 an hour.
feesNamed: $1,500 refundable security deposit (aircraft rates rise $10 an hour if you decline it)
Temporary fuel surcharge of $0.90 a gallon from May 11, 2026, while fuel exceeds $5.75 a gallon
No block rates; pay as you go on Hobbs time
bestFor: Students who want every charge written down before they sign up.
skipIf: You prefer prepaid block rates; it does not offer them.
watchOut: A fuel surcharge applies while fuel is above $5.75 a gallon (effective May 11, 2026), so the wet rate can rise.
The $1,500 deposit is refundable minus outstanding charges.
The page lists no private pilot total.
